content: STEP 1 — Scope screen of the three proposals against the frozen bundle. Goal: decide which candidates satisfy the five-part scope contract before ranking. Read: the full task prompt, the three proposal specifications, and the frozen evidence bundles 873c522da0fe18b8 (FLOWCURV-RQ), 0f797cdb944e7fd3 (GEOCAP-RQ), 0cd9a2ca0d1fca02 (geoflow-metric-rq), especially E5 successor-entropy stratification, E6 beam survival, E8 first-level capacity ceiling, E11 prefix diagnostic, and each E12/E13 geometry statement. Observation: FLOWCURV-RQ and GEOCAP-RQ each name a training-only transition statistic, an explicit curved operation with negative curvature and a geodesic/area-law computation inside the quantizer, and a single pathway in which assignment and reconstruction read the same codebook array; both state the three switches and a one-run Stage3 Recall target. geoflow-metric-rq uses lambda_k = 1 - min((||c_k||/max_j||c_j||)^2, 1-1/K), a clamped Euclidean codeword-radius scalar; there is no curvature parameter c, no geodesic distance, no exp/log map, and the expression is not the Poincare conformal factor (which grows as 1/(1-z^2)). It is therefore a geometry name attached to an anisotropic Euclidean penalty, so it fails scope criterion 2/3. Open: rank FLOWCURV-RQ and GEOCAP-RQ on evidence-grounded expected single-run performance, with geoflow-metric-rq last.

STEP 2 — Comparative evidence check between the two in-scope candidates. Read: E5 (successor entropy and top-1 successor mass vary from H=0.931/top1=0.438 in bin 1 to H=3.405/top1=0.054 in bin 5; Spearman -0.973), E6 (prior l1_br collapses to recall 0.04671 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, while l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and resample 0.06363; best historical 0.0638 vs target 0.065), E8 (share of canonical pairs in the same K-cluster falls from 0.3106 at K=16 to 0.0822 at K=256, so a 256-way level allocates behavioural capacity poorly), E9 (train-only cohort-profile positive/negative 0.9291/0.8871, a real but modest signal), E11 (same first prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067, weak). Observation: GEOCAP-RQ's behavioural demand is a popularity-adjusted directed-transition salience aggregated per codeword, which is directly aligned with the measured successor-entropy/top-1-mass stratification and with the E8 capacity-ceiling diagnosis; its per-codeword geodesic cell radius is a capacity allocation on the same fixed chart/codebook, so it does not move positions and can break a one-prefix level by penalising low-demand codewords. FLOWCURV-RQ's signal is signed net in-out flow divergence, for which the bundle reports no measured variance or correlation with successor entropy; under a level-2 collapse to one codeword the mass-weighted average net flow is near the global zero, so s_hat and the curvature correction tend to zero exactly where the mechanism must act. This makes GEOCAP-RQ the stronger single-run bet on the frozen evidence. Open: final positions and objection wording.

STEP 3 — Final ranking. Complete answer below.
